FAQ

Questions before you start.

Clear answers before you start your next research workflow.

How is Research Master different from regular AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, or Google Gemini?

Regular AI assistants are useful for quick answers, rewriting text, or creating short summaries. Research Master is built more like a research workflow. It is designed for tasks that require finding information, comparing sources, and turning findings into a structured workspace. It searches across multiple professional sources in real time and uses separate analysis modules for areas such as companies, industries, competitors, markets, and risks. The result is a set of organized findings with source references whenever possible, so you can review the original information.

Can I trust AI-generated content? Are the data and conclusions traceable?

Traceability is one of the main design goals of Research Master. The system prioritizes public records, industry reports, news sources, official data, social platforms, and other available references. Important conclusions are checked across multiple sources when possible. Research runs are organized around summaries, analysis, verification, risk notes, and recommendations. Source references stay attached to key findings so you can review the original material. That said, AI-generated content may still contain gaps, outdated information, or interpretation errors. We recommend using Research Master as research support, not as the only basis for important decisions.

Can I start with incomplete input? Does it support multilingual research?

Yes. You can start with a company name, product name, competitor URL, website, article, or PDF document. Even if your input is brief, the system will identify the research type and fill in the common analysis areas automatically. Research Master supports multilingual source processing, which makes it useful for global market research, cross-border products, and international competitor analysis. Findings can be exported as Markdown, PDF, or PPTX for editing, sharing, or internal review.

What research scenarios is Research Master best for? Will it miss important areas?

Research Master is best suited for three main scenarios: Product or company research: company background, team, funding, product positioning, competitors, and operating data. Industry or market research: market size, key players, technology trends, regulation, and business models. Solution or feasibility research: recommendations, execution conditions, practical steps, risks, and next actions. The system automatically covers the common key areas based on the research type. However, report quality also depends on how much reliable public information is available. For high-stakes decisions, you should still review the sources and apply your own judgment.

Can I use it without research or analysis experience? How long does a report take?

Yes. You do not need professional research experience. Just enter a research target, such as a company name, product name, industry keyword, or URL. The system will decide what to research, where to look, and how to organize the findings. Most standard research tasks can be completed in about 30 minutes. More complex topics, larger source sets, or deeper analysis may take longer.

Is Research Master free to use?

Yes. Research Master offers a free version for trying the basic features. If you need to generate more reports or use higher usage limits, you can upgrade to a paid plan. Please check the pricing page on the official website for the latest details.

How is Research Master different from regular AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, or Google Gemini?

常规人工智能助手对于快速回答、重写文本或创建简短摘要非常有用。 Research Master 的构建更像是一个研究工作流程。 它专为需要查找信息、比较来源以及将发现转化为结构化工作空间的任务而设计。 它实时搜索多个专业来源，并对公司、行业、竞争对手、市场和风险等领域使用单独的分析模块。 结果是一组有组织的发现，并尽可能提供源参考，以便您可以查看原始信息。

Can I trust AI-generated content? Are the data and conclusions traceable?

可追溯性是Research Master的主要设计目标之一。 该系统优先考虑公共记录、行业报告、新闻来源、官方数据、社交平台和其他可用参考。 尽可能通过多个来源检查重要结论。 研究运行围绕总结、分析、验证、风险说明和建议进行组织。 来源参考文献附在关键发现上，以便您可以查看原始材料。 也就是说，人工智能生成的内容可能仍然包含空白、过时的信息或解释错误。 我们建议使用研究硕士作为研究支持，而不是作为重要决策的唯一依据。

Can I start with incomplete input? Does it support multilingual research?

是的。 您可以从公司名称、产品名称、竞争对手 URL、网站、文章或 PDF 文档开始。 即使您的输入很简短，系统也会识别研究类型并自动填写常见分析区域。 Research Master支持多语言源处理，这对于全球市场研究、跨境产品和国际竞争对手分析非常有用。 结果可以导出为 Markdown、PDF 或 PPTX，以便编辑、共享或内部审阅。

What research scenarios is Research Master best for? Will it miss important areas?

研究硕士最适合三个主要场景： 产品或公司研究：公司背景、团队、资金、产品定位、竞争对手和运营数据。 行业或市场研究：市场规模、主要参与者、技术趋势、监管和商业模式。 解决方案或可行性研究：建议、执行条件、实际步骤、风险和下一步行动。 系统根据研究类型自动覆盖共同的关键领域。 然而，报告的质量还取决于可获得多少可靠的公共信息。 对于高风险的决策，您仍然应该查看来源并运用自己的判断。

Can I use it without research or analysis experience? How long does a report take?

是的。 您不需要专业的研究经验。 只需输入研究目标，例如公司名称、产品名称、行业关键字或 URL。 系统将决定研究什么、在哪里寻找以及如何组织研究结果。 大多数标准研究任务可以在大约 30 分钟内完成。 更复杂的主题、更大的源集或更深入的分析可能需要更长的时间。

Is Research Master free to use?

是的。 Research Master 提供免费版本来尝试基本功能。 如果您需要生成更多报告或使用更高的使用限制，可以升级到付费计划。 最新详情请查看官网定价页面。
